strings.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
strings.role: Basketball forward · NBA champion and MVP
strings.summary: Born in Athens to Nigerian immigrants, Antetokounmpo progressed from Greek club basketball to the NBA. His size, speed and rim attacks underpin his two-way influence. A two-time regular-season MVP, he led Milwaukee to the 2021 title as Finals MVP and also represented Greece. Traded to Miami in 2026, his development carries symbolic significance for migration across continents and sport.

strings.influence.rationale: An NBA champion and MVP whose cross-continental immigrant upbringing carries symbolic influence for sporting development.
